novelty.mechanism: For each young source only, compress the two leg-type channels (A_s,P_s) to one shared spatial matrix H_s with two metered fnp coefficient arrays. This is a rank-1 approximation across the 2-dimensional leg-type/channel axis, not across neuron/source/spatial axes.
explicit_exclusions: R247 V25-NM24-YOUNG-D21-RIGHT-SPARSIFY: no 2:4/N:M or entry sparsity
R248 V25-KRON1-YOUNG-TRANSPORT: no Kronecker/tensor-product approximation of WD
R244 MP-R16: no marginal-preserving remainder range finder

math.pair_matrix: X_s = stack(vec(A_s), vec(P_s)) in R^{2 x n^2}
math.candidate: best rank-1 channel surrogate Xhat_s = sigma_1 u_1 v_1^T; reshape v_1 to H_s, so Ahat_s=a_s H_s and Phat_s=p_s H_s
math.production_extraction: Use the 2x2 Gram of the two fnp arrays and closed-form principal direction with fnp.sum/fnp.sqrt/fnp.maximum and fnp array division; coefficients remain fnp arrays and are never materialized to Python float.
math.downstream_collapse: With Ahat=aH and Phat=pH, the two young dense D21 right-factor contractions LA@Ahat.T + LP@Phat.T collapse to (a*LA+p*LP)@H.T, one dense contraction instead of two. Transport likewise carries one H instead of separate A/P.

forbidden: NumPy/SciPy/Torch/JAX numerical work in estimator predict
float/bool/int materialization of fnp numerical values
source_compliance.allowed_contract: shape/control/bookkeeping only in Python; numerical constants may participate only as operands of metered fnp array operations
source_compliance.offline_falsifier_note: NumPy is permitted only in the target-free offline falsifier and is not candidate estimator/submission code.

public_panel_if_authorized.execution: At most one preverified-free standard GitHub Actions workflow, no retry, only after every preregistration gate passes.

stop_conditions: Novelty collision with history is found
Production source would require output-affecting math.* or unresolved unmetered Python scalar arithmetic
Free standard Actions cannot be verified before public execution
